description: This file defines the class VideoFrameReleaseTimeHelper, which adjusts frame release timestamps for smoother video playback by synchronizing with display vsync signals and compensating for drift.

classes.name: VideoFrameReleaseTimeHelper
classes.description: A helper class to adjust video frame release times for smoother playback by aligning with display vsync signals.

classes.name: VSyncSampler
classes.description: A singleton class that samples display vsync timestamps using Choreographer, shared across instances of VideoFrameReleaseTimeHelper.

methods.name: adjustReleaseTime
methods.description: Adjusts a frame's release timestamp based on vsync timing and playback rate to improve smoothness.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the helper, starting vsync sampling if applicable.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the helper, stopping vsync sampling.

methods.name: onSynced
methods.description: Hook method called when synchronization occurs; default does nothing.
